evidence_summary: Replay capture shows collections/create accepting properties.collection.ttl.seconds=-100 with http=200/code=0, reproduced twice (REQ2 and REQ6 after drop/recreate), while the same value on alter_properties is rejected twice with code=1100 'collection TTL is out of range, expect [-1, 3155760000], got -100' (REQ4/REQ8 control), and describe (REQ3/REQ7) confirms the collection exists yet does not list the ttl property.
rationale: Semantic match to Type1_IllegalSuccess with clear reproducibility: an out-of-range parameter is accepted with a success response at create even though the server's own validation on the identical property declares it invalid, violating the documented range constraint (ttlSeconds >= 0) and behavioral constraint 002 (400 on invalid parameters); the two full create/describe/alter cycles give 2 successful reproductions plus a control, and the maintainer by-design references (e.g. 50351 unconsumed top-level fields) concern ignored top-level payload fields, not properties validation, so no by-design defense covers this inconsistent acceptance.
